summary: Decide whether a friend key is active
description: A friend key is active, expired, or revoked. Revoked wins over a future expiry. Times are ISO-8601 strings compared as strings.
scope: A future expiry that is not revoked is active
Now at or after expires_at is expired
Revoked stays revoked while the expiry is still in the future
constraints: Compare the timestamp strings. Do not parse them with datetime.
Do not return a reason sentence.
Do not read a key file.
workerGuidance: Small local model rule: solve only the active subtask. Do not implement later CTX tasks early.
Every test function for this task's subtasks must contain that slice token, for example CTX_075_1.
After writing or changing a test, always call the declared pytest command before ending the turn. Do not stop with explanation text only.
If the active subtask's verification already passes because earlier work implemented it correctly, run the declared command and mark the subtask done. Do not rewrite unrelated files.
Keep edits inside targetArtifacts unless the subtask explicitly says otherwise.
When writing tests, assert only the current subtask's scope so later subtasks still have meaningful work.

subtasks.title: Accept a current key
subtasks.summary: A future expiry that is not revoked returns active.
instructions: Name the test function so it contains CTX_075_1.
This subtask's only job: A future expiry that is not revoked returns active.
Touch only src/context_mgmt/friend_keys.py and tests/test_ctx_075_1_active.py unless the test needs an existing import helper.
Do not edit tests for other CTX subtasks in this attempt.
key_status(expires_at, revoked, now) compares the strings. revoked false and now < expires_at returns active.
The test must call key_status.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_ctx_075_1_active.py -q -k CTX_075_1.
businessRules: A key is active only while now is before expires_at and revoked is false.
